title: Light Wands
description: This mod adds wands capable of generating blocks of light.
body:
Combine 4 blazepower and create a fireball. Let the fireball absorb some sunlight and in a few seconds it will turn into a ball of light. Use it to create light staffs.

To use the staff, just right-click on any block.

Oh, don’t let it rain on your fireball!

Any suggestion or bug, please join the discord server.
